result_revision.change_summary: Initial maintainer-local schema-v3 replay of the retained Geometry super scarce Transolver result (epoch 1000).

model: Transolver surface and volume, Geometry super scarce, epoch 1000

methodology.record_note: Candidate mechanics replay from the retained Geometry super scarce resolved training configurations, raw loaded checkpoint hashes, training logs, and complete native-support Slurm inference. Training timing uses conservative retained calendar envelopes; inference timing uses the recorded campaign allocation ledger. This local record is not an accepted submission.

architecture.description: Two independently trained PhysicsNeMo Transolver models: one predicts nine native surface channels and one predicts six native flow-domain channels. Both use 16 Transolver layers, hidden width 320, eight attention heads, MLP ratio four, and 256 slices.

components.description: Six-input, nine-output, 16-layer Transolver for native surface points.
Seven-input, six-output, 16-layer Transolver for retained valid native flow-domain points.

key_hyperparameters.name: Training sampling resolution
key_hyperparameters.description: Maximum sampled native points per case during training.

input_features.name: Surface coordinates and normals
input_features.description: Three native point coordinates and three vehicle surface-normal components.

input_features.name: Freestream velocity
input_features.description: The case freestream velocity expanded at queried surface points.

input_features.name: Volume coordinates, signed distance, and signed-distance normals
input_features.description: Three native point coordinates, scalar signed distance, and three signed-distance-normal components.

input_features.name: Freestream velocity
input_features.description: The case freestream velocity expanded at queried volume points.

predicted_fields.description: Surface pressure is a direct output channel.
The three wall-shear-stress components are direct output channels.
The three nondimensional velocity components are direct output channels.
Nondimensional flow-domain pressure is a direct output channel.

data_handling.normalization: Dataset transforms nondimensionalize fields from case metadata; fixed training-set channel centering/scaling is applied by the retained training pipeline. Inference reverses model normalization before scoring nondimensional pressure, wall shear, and velocity.
data_handling.preprocessing: Surface inputs use native coordinates and vehicle normals. Volume inputs are centered native coordinates augmented with signed distance and signed-distance normals; the freestream vector is expanded per query.
data_handling.sampling: Training samples at most 200000 native points per case. Geometry super scarce inference deterministically traverses every retained native support point in bounded chunks and scores immediately without retaining dense prediction fields.

stages.description: From-scratch distributed training on the official Geometry super scarce surface training split. Retained logs cover 1000 complete epochs.

loss.description: Huber loss over predicted surface fields.
loss.weighting: pressure=2.0, temperature=0.25, density=0.5, velocity=0.5, wall shear=1.0

compute.hardware: Four-GPU NVIDIA Slurm training allocations recorded by the retained rank logs; exact accelerator SKU requires owner metadata confirmation
compute.measurement_notes: Conservative calendar envelope from the first through final retained optimizer-step timestamps, multiplied by the four recorded ranks; it includes any restart gaps and must be replaced by summed Slurm allocation time before an official release.
